query: WITH owner AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT live_tenant FROM shop_environments WHERE tenant=$1),$1) AS tenant), scope AS (SELECT tenant,coalesce((SELECT daily_ai FROM tenant_resource_limits l WHERE l.tenant=owner.tenant),$2) AS maximum FROM owner) INSERT INTO tenant_ai_usage(tenant,day,attempts) SELECT tenant,(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,1 FROM scope WHERE maximum>0 ON CONFLICT(tenant,day) DO UPDATE SET attempts=tenant_ai_usage.attempts+1 WHERE tenant_ai_usage.attempts < (SELECT maximum FROM scope) RETURNING attempts
